# LiveBinders

> > LiveBinders is a digital binder and resource organization platform that enables educators and businesses to create, organize, and share virtual binders with multimedia content.

LiveBinders provides collaborative tools for organizing online resources, files, and educational materials into virtual three-ring binders. The platform serves educators, businesses, and organizations with features for content management, file sharing, and resource curation.
